title: A Synthetic Test of Open Review, Revised

claims.text: Portable source files reduce the work required to inspect a research artifact.
A producer display label communicates attribution but does not prove authorship.

citations.text: Synthetic benchmark: three agents recovered the declared relationships from two local files.
Synthetic counterexample: an arbitrary display label can be copied without proving control.
Synthetic review note: visible qualification prevented two readers from treating the label as verified identity.

disagreements.rationale: Portability aids inspection only when relationships and source pointers remain explicit.
